node.title: N=256 square-mass-16 E=38 quotient-Schur exclusion
node.statement: For profile (3,4,0) at V=76, the exact slack recurrence gives E=38 and L<=22. A complete mod-16 quotient census bounds the three exceptional magnitude profiles: the two-layer maxima are 2782, 2760, 2580, and 2422, while the outer 30-point Schur term is at most 840. Together with the exact top-layer zero and the proved 4Z autocorrelation-subfield exclusion, every live candidate has M_3<=2796<2806. The rational cubic-Hermite certificate therefore puts the norm below 2^250 and excludes V=76. Every unresolved vector in this profile has positive even V<=74.
node.notes: ROUTE CLOSURE 2026-07-27: a complete 43,153,083-allocation quotient census and the existing subfield cut close the variance-76 slice without new assumptions. Lower positive even variances remain open.
